task: Set the versioning scheme for the new public API library.

candidate_memories.content: Public API libraries use semantic versioning (SemVer 2.0): MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; MAJOR for breaking changes, MINOR for backwards-compatible features, PATCH for bug fixes. Changelog entry is mandatory for every release.
Use semantic versioning for all releases.
candidate_memories.notes: deduplication: superseded by rde009-p1; no SemVer definition or changelog requirement

candidate_memories.content: All public libraries follow SemVer; bump MAJOR on breaking API changes.
Internal tools and CLIs may use date-based versioning (YYYY.MM.DD); public APIs must use SemVer.
v1.0.0 release is planned for end of quarter; this is the first stable release.
